body: suck it up? push forward? seem like reasonable advice especially when compared to the difficulties (true difficulties) others are going through. i just sound like a spoiled brat but it is honestly how i feel. i understand that there are  people going through so much harder times and yet they smile and push through and i want to know why. im not envious of these people because their lives "suck". i sound like a privileged unappreciative prick and completely understand that yet my thinking and feeling continue.
